raw:
Pierre Gasly's 2023 teammate at Alpine was Esteban Ocon. Gasly and Ocon both appear for Alpine F1 Team in the 2023 race reports I found (Monaco, Miami, and the United States Grand Prix), and the 2023 final standings list both drivers for Alpine (Gasly 62 pts, Ocon 58 pts). The searches don't show a race where either of them was absent, so Ocon was his teammate for the whole season. I did not check every round individually, so this rests on the reports and standings I retrieved.

ANSWER: Esteban Ocon
